repository_catalog_methods: Public subset of two independently reconciled paginated organization catalogs. Private repository metadata is omitted.
notes: Counts are observed during this finite read window. Future pushes, comments and closures can change them.
Conflicts mean mergeable=false or mergeable_state=dirty. Blocked/unstable checks do not count as conflicts.
Only open PR heads are inventoried. Non-PR diagnostic branches are excluded.
Review resolution uses is_resolved, including outdated unresolved threads.
Search-index counts changed during initial pagination; canonical per-repository lists are authoritative.
actual_base is read from the raw target branch ref; pr_base_at_read is GitHub's potentially stale PR metadata field.
